note: Fix pass 38 of pull request #296. Every changed line decides whether a review that another replaced may still write to the review index, its verification, its restatement links or its verdict, so every mutant is owed. Each killed or new-test claim ran against its named test alone, with exactly one test collected, and its test failed. The six equivalent claims did not run; each gives its reason. On the first run, mutant 49 named the retired-wave test, which expects superseded and so passed with the throw forced on; it was run again against a review that verifies and completes, and that test failed.
